## Protocol authors (EMPRESS study)

Members of the network come from China, the United Kingdom, Chile, Mexico, and France. The 13 investigators below are the authors of the EMPRESS protocol (as published); members of the Steering, Coordinating, and Data Safety Monitoring Committees are listed under [Governance](../governance.html).
